svg.title: TwinLLM data flow
svg.desc: Metro map of how data moves through TwinLLM. Wearable data is downloaded from Oura, Whoop and Google Health, converted to FHIR R4 and stored as snapshots. BodyLoop scans come from the local network into the Digital Twin viewer, which also shows pinned anatomy atlases, the 67 Anchor biomarkers and a full-screen environment. Guideline passages and OpenTwin knowledge notes are embedded locally into pgvector. A Synthea cohort (v4, seed 42) is loaded with warehouse:ingest into the synthetic warehouse, read by closed query and analytics tools. Summaries and tool results go to an open model served by Ollama on this machine, which writes the chat answer; the same pipeline runs the 81-question synthetic evaluation. Infomaniak (legacy), OpenRouter, the remote GPU and the GBD server are off this machine and refused in local-only mode; OpenRouter and the remote GPU take synthetic data only. Our own models on an Exoscale A30 instance in Switzerland are the default cloud provider; the instance and notifications are planned.
